items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: And you got to be good friends, I guess. Always good friends.

ctx.x: Well, we used to play on the same order. I mostly played my style. Where did you see him playing at then? Well, I used to be with him for all the time. When he was playing with Rene, he'd send me in his place when he couldn't go. Uh-huh. And you got to be good friends, I guess. Always good friends. Yeah. He was a good trombone player. He was a good trombone player. He was a good trombone player. He was a good trombone player. He was a good trombone player. He was a good trombone player. That's funny because when…
Yeah, but I said that to you. Yeah, Hassan Bradley. Hassan Bradley. That was my favorite trombone player.
